ask: Write the commit message for the hands-free fix.
label: Shipped
required: A hands-free press queued behind a paste lost its second press
The take stayed listening with the microphone on
The queued press now records the stop that belongs to its mode, and the replay calls it
reference:
A hands-free take queued behind a paste stops on its second press (#97)

A press that arrives while a landed paste finishes is queued and replayed once the paste is done, with its release, so a tap stays a tap. A hands-free press is ended by a second press, not a release, and stopHandsFree() during .inserting was ignored: the replay started a hands-free take that nothing stopped, and the microphone stayed on. That is CI's seed-45 failure in the gesture storm.

The queued press now records the stop that belongs to its mode (its release for a hold, its second press for hands-free) and the replay calls that same stop. A hands-free press's release still means nothing.

The shipping app does not reach this: AppState begins hands-free only from a double tap while idle, so a queued press is always a hold. The controller is where the promise lives, so the fix is there.

The storm's inserter now holds 20 ms after the text lands, as the real one holds its clipboard restore floor, so gestures land inside the paste on every run. Without the fix, 14 of 200 seeds fail this way; with it, none, also with every core busy.
